    # Near-limit inputs (expected values from a reference solution; see test_audit/)
    def _big(seed, scale=1.0):
        import random
        rng = random.Random(seed)
        H, W = {1: (8, 25), 2: (12, 16), 3: (2, 100)}.get(seed, (8, 25))
        W = max(2, int(W * scale))
        col = [[0] * W for _ in range(H)]
        for i in range(H):
            for j in range(W):
                opts = [c for c in (1, 2, 3) if (i == 0 or col[i - 1][j] != c) and (j == 0 or col[i][j - 1] != c)]
                col[i][j] = rng.choice(opts)
        rows = [''.join((str(col[i][j]) if rng.random() < 0.08 else '?' for j in range(W))) for i in range(H)]
        return (H, W, rows)
    assert candidate(*_big(1)) == 170048119
    assert candidate(*_big(2)) == 394955350
    assert candidate(*_big(3)) == 369503617
